name: universal love
description: A deep sense that everything and everyone is bound together and worth experiencing.

variations.name: agape
variations.description: The Christian concept of unconditional love, representing God's love for humans and the love Christians should strive to have for one another.

variations.name: loving-kindness
variations.description: The Buddhist concept of compassionate universal love extended to all beings.

commentaries.quote: One has to glimpse a very broad and selfless view of existence to accept and value everything.
Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
Universal love is neither natural nor easy. It's another of the rare human superpowers that not enough strive for.

conditions: A sense that everything and everyone is bound together and worth experiencing. There's no need to optimize or change things.
